name: Tangem Pay
summary: Non-custodial Visa card for spending USDC directly from your self-custody Tangem wallet. Available in US, LATAM, and APAC with EU expansion planned.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the Tangem Pay charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Tangem Pay?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
